title: Gold relations
description: Hand-verified relationship ground truth for one novel, closed-world over the in-scope character pairs. Pinned to a corpus PDF checksum exactly like the gold roster, and names characters by the roster's canonical_name.

scope_tiers.description: A pair is in scope only if both characters have one of these tiers in the gold roster. Predicted edges outside scope are not scored.

ignored_predicates.description: Predicates exempt from the closed-world assumption: predicted edges using them are dropped before scoring.

alt_predicates.description: Predicates equally acceptable as a match (an antagonistic phase reads as enemy_of or rival_of).

arc.description: Entries of one pair sharing an arc id are an ordered temporal sequence (antagonistic, then engaged, then married). Each entry after the first is a transition scored by chapter.
